findings.source_issue: The source interleaves binary expansions without specifying one representation for each input. Dyadic numbers have two expansions, and 1 needs its all-ones fractional expansion for the displayed rule to cover the closed unit interval. Without a convention the construction is not a well-defined function and the digit-equality injection argument is incomplete.
findings.minimal_treatment: Choose the non-eventually-all-ones expansion below 1 and the all-ones fractional expansion for 1, then state the resulting injection proof.

Under a valid convention covering 1, f(1,0)=0.1010..., so the proposed witness is in the image. The source also misnames the expansions as decimal in the summary.
